description:
Total Value Locked for a whole blockchain such as Ethereum, Base or Solana. Returns USD TVL and the top protocols on that chain. Use it when the user asks about a chain's overall DeFi footprint.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

name: get_chain_tvl
